source: National Park Service (NPS) & The Mountaineers Ten Essentials (Public Domain / Educational Guidance)

ten_essentials.name: Offline Topo Map, Compass & Charged Phone (AegisHiker Pack Loaded)
ten_essentials.reason: Ten Essentials #1: Always carry a physical or offline map/compass and verify regional pack is cached offline.

ten_essentials.name: Headlamp + Spare Batteries / Charging Cable
ten_essentials.reason: Ten Essentials #2: Essential if delayed past sunset or navigating forest canopy at dusk.

ten_essentials.name: Sunglasses, Broad-Brim Hat & SPF 30+ Sunscreen
ten_essentials.reason: Ten Essentials #3: UV exposure increases ~4% per 300 m (1,000 ft) of elevation gain.

ten_essentials.name: Backcountry First-Aid Kit + Blister Care (Leukotape/Moleskin)
ten_essentials.reason: Ten Essentials #4: Treat blisters, sprains, and minor cuts immediately on trail.

ten_essentials.name: Multi-tool / Pocket Knife & Duct Tape Strip
ten_essentials.reason: Ten Essentials #5: Gear repair and emergency utility.

ten_essentials.name: Waterproof Matches / Lighter & Tinder
ten_essentials.reason: Ten Essentials #6: Emergency warmth and signaling.

ten_essentials.name: Ultralight Emergency Bivy Sack or Space Blanket
ten_essentials.reason: Ten Essentials #7: Wind and hypothermia protection if immobilized.

ten_essentials.name: Extra Day's Emergency High-Calorie Trail Ration (Bars, Nuts, Electrolytes)
ten_essentials.reason: Ten Essentials #8: Sustains energy and body heat during unexpected delays.

ten_essentials.name: Water Bottles/Reservoir + Water Filter (Sawyer/Katadyn) or Purification Tablets
ten_essentials.reason: Ten Essentials #9: Never drink untreated surface water; carry capacity for calculated trip need.

ten_essentials.name: Insulating Mid-Layer (Fleece/Puffy) & Waterproof/Windproof Rain Shell
ten_essentials.reason: Ten Essentials #10: Mountain weather shifts rapidly; avoid cotton.

conditional_items.name: Microspikes / Trail Crampons & Insulated Gloves
conditional_items.reason: Recommended for snow/ice trail conditions or alpine routes above 2,200 m (7,200 ft).

conditional_items.name: Adjustable Trekking Poles (Pair)
conditional_items.reason: Reduces knee impact on steep descents (>12% grade or >500 m elevation gain/loss).

conditional_items.name: Waterproof Trail Gaiters & Spare Merino Socks
conditional_items.reason: Trail condition flagged for mud or stream crossings.

conditional_items.name: Collapsible Dog Bowl, Leash, Waste Bags, Paw Balm & Extra 1.0 L Water
conditional_items.reason: Hiking with dog(s): pack extra water and paw protection for rocky terrain.

conditional_items.name: 10,000 mAh USB Power Bank & Weatherproof Phone Pouch
conditional_items.reason: Continuous GPS tracking on hikes over 4 hours benefits from backup battery power.
